exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because the frozen FIX-002 instruction, flag, FPU, exception, self-modification, and memory suite cannot be assembled while BPTK-002 owns no frozen denominator, and the MMX, SSE/SSE2, x87 80-bit intermediate precision, fs-relative addressing, address-size override, and full CPUID leaf breadth do not exist. The bounded subset now covers the byte-granular integer space (the two-operand ALU byte column, the al,imm8 column, the 0x80/0x82 byte immediate group, byte mov/moffs/test, the 0xfe group), cwde/cbw/cdq/cwd, xchg, pop r/m, pusha/popa, the carry operation, sahf/lahf, wait, xlat, the loop family, cmovcc, the bt/bts/btr/btc family, bsf/bsr, shld/shrd, cmpxchg, xadd, the hint NOP family, and the flat-model segment and lock prefix, while fs/gs and the privileged and port instruction stop as named structured refusal; rep serves cmps/scas under a declared 2^20 iteration bound and the cmps operand bug (EAX instead of [edi]) is fixed.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-002 passes the pinned instruction, flag, FPU, exception, self-modification, and memory suite.
expected_failing_assertion: The complete i386 microprogram suite cannot execute to its frozen reference machine state while BPTK-002 owns no frozen denominator, and instruction outside the bounded subset stop as structured unsupported.
active_gate_evidence: Seventy-three runtime check exercise the real bptk run surface: the 38-case microprogram conformance suite in test/i386.test.mjs freezes hand-derived reference machine state (every register and every architecturally defined flag, bit-exact, with the BT-family and BSF/BSR undefined field declared) and the declared opcode inventory is proven consistent with the probe over ~560 executed microprogram where every declared-served opcode executes and every undeclared opcode stops with the stable structured diagnostic; plus the prior integer, flag, memory, rollback, and determinism coverage. The committed decode sweep moved the real corpus .text coverage to Plink i386 94.0% and OpenTTD i386 95.1%.
procedure: Run each microprogram with deterministic memory and instruction budget.
Compare registers, flags, exception, FPU, memory, and trace hash.
pass_criterion: All required instruction cases match the reference state.
Unsupported instruction produces a stable diagnostic rather than divergence.
